title: Q-SELF-WORKER: the tick Worker reports k_self and the regime next to k_eff (SELF-REFERENCE-1 parity)
body:

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=seed/worker/src/criticality.js

foundation/criticality.py now computes k_self (verified deploys the system originated on itself: origin executor or self-agent) and the regime (self-sustaining, driven, subcritical). deploy/deploy-workers.mjs writes `origin` on every ops/deploys.jsonl row. Carry `origin` through ingestDeploys (seed/worker/src/selfaudit.js) into the outcome evidence, count self-originated verified deploys in windowFigures, return k_self and regime from computeKEff, show both in /live next to k_eff, and add a worker test that an outside-origin deploy raises k_eff but not k_self.
